meta.name: agf-writing-github-issue
meta.description: Use whenever a user, product-lead, or qa-engineer wants to create a GitHub issue in the project repo — including phrases like "提一个 issue / 写一个 issue / 报 bug / 把这个开成 issue / gh issue / 上 GitHub / track 一下 / 立个 ticket". Provides the required-field skeleton, locked label set (type / area / epic / priority / severity / phase), gh CLI heredoc template, and the QA-auto-issue exception path. Replaces ad-hoc `gh issue create` calls with inconsistent titles / missing labels / freestyle bodies.

copy.tagline: 快速创建格式规范的 GitHub issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要创建 GitHub issue 但总忘记填标签或格式不统一。
